beats.text: Six moments that reveal someone's true character.
One. How they treat people who can do absolutely nothing for them.
Two. How they handle losing — gracefully, or with bitterness.
Three. What they do when they're certain no one is watching.
Four. How they talk about people who aren't in the room.
Five. How they react to someone else's good news — genuine joy, or a flicker of envy.
Six. How they treat someone who just made an honest mistake.
Character isn't what people say about themselves. It's what they do when it's inconvenient to be good.
